3698-4131-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3698-4131-5660-6769.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Grinding Station and Surge Conductor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Basalt Monolith, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-4681-5170-8175.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

1339-1832-1939-4050.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-1939-4050.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

147-413-1854.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-1854.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2464-3249-6920--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-6920--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-6920--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

222-308-4247-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-4247-4871.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire abilities
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3564-4275-5329-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
3564-4275-5329-6495.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3564-4275-5329-6495.notes:
You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-728-955-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-955-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

757-2348-5087-6702.easyPrerequisites:
Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Kilo, or you have another method to tap Kilo.
757-2348-5087-6702.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Kilo to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Nature's Revolt, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1368-3755-6321-7296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-6321-7296.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1636-6798-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-5921-5970-7297.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2921-6517-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2624-3169-4050-6992.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of creatures equal to or greater than 7 plus Leonardo's commander tax, if applicable.
2624-3169-4050-6992.description:
Cast Leonardo either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} due to its cost reduction.
God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
When Leonardo enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonardo, adding {W}.
Put Leonardo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2820-3175-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2060-4518-6930-6967.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2-2639-3254-4050.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2-2639-3254-4050.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Ancestral Statue and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ancestral Statue enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Ancestral Statue and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2-2639-3254-4050.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

3967-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1680-2557-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3197-5789-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-5789-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2781-4875-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2438-2781-4875-6243.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1432-1486-1753-4875.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.
1432-1486-1753-4875.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability. You can also use Ioreth's second ability instead.

2558-2829-5687-5692.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

112-565-4600-6203.manaNeeded: {3}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
112-565-4600-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Throne of Eldraine.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as its color as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness
with a fade counter on it

2335-3143-4613-4704.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2335-3143-4613-4704.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a Saproling creature token.
Activate Xavier Sal using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

341-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
341-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3200-5445-5660.notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
3200-5445-5660.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Urza's Bauble ability, causing you to look at a card in a player's hand, and causing you to draw a card at the beginning of the next upkeep step.
Repeat.

141-2034-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-2034-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1430-1621.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirror Image.
1430-1621.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Mirror Image. Choose to have Mirror Image enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2921-5523.notablePrerequisites: Defiant Greatmaw does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2921-5523.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1308-1527-4911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of artifacts greater than two times the indestructible creature's toughness.
1308-1527-4911.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1272-2051-2546-3178.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1272-2051-2546-3178.description:
Activate Forgotten Cave's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Forgotten Cave ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Seismic Assault ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Forgotten Cave and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

498-2050-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Arbor Elf.
Elvish Guidance attached to a Forest you control.
Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three Elves.
498-2050-2816.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the Forest that has Elvish Guidance attached.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Elvish Guidance triggers, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Arbor Elf by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

39-2034-2302-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Alabaster Dragon, adding {C}{C}.
Alabaster Dragon and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Alabaster Dragon trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Alabaster Dragon, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
